europe_now.title: US and Denmark Establish Greenland Defense Agreement
europe_now.summary: The United States is set to construct two new military bases in Greenland under the terms of a newly finalized defense agreement with Denmark. This strategic development highlights evolving security arrangements within the Arctic region.

sources.headline: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
